sources.title: Swift 1.5 Qwen3.8-27B with Unsloth IQ3_XXS GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The build starts from Swift 1.5 BF16 weights and applies our own tensor-by-tensor mixed quantization layout, reconstructed from the public UD-IQ3_XXS reference in Unsloth's Qwen3.8 GGUF repository, using Unsloth's public importance matrix.

sources.title: Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-GGUF · Models
sources.snippet: Compact, mixed-precision GGUF quantizations of Swift 1.5 Qwen3.8-27B, with Swift-specific refinement using the per-tensor allocations from ISTA-DASLab's GSQ-RCO release. Swift 1.5 builds on Swift 1.0 through post-training focused on long-horizon, agentic and coding tasks, improving overall performance while using fewer thinking tokens.
